title: Infinite rational distance sets in affine general position: constructions in every dimension
summary: For every integer $d\geq 1$, we construct a countably infinite set $X_d\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ in affine general position, with all pairwise distances rational. When $d$ is odd, $X_d$ may also be chosen so that no $d+2$ points lie on a common sphere. The construction is uniform in $d$: positive Chebyshev square decompositions produce harmonic curves on spheres whose points corresponding to rational parameter values have pairwise rational distances.
